اقترفن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَفْنَ (iqtarafna) /iq.ta.raf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اُقْتُرِفْنَ (uqturifna) /uq.tu.rif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اِقْتَرِفْنَ (iqtarifna) /iq.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
